name: C20-22 alcohols
description: C20-22 Alcohols (CAS 90604-34-5 ) are a blend of long-chain fatty alcohols used as emulsifiers, thickeners, and emollients across personal care and industrial formulations. Their high carbon chain length positions them as functional wax-like ingredients. These alcohols are essential where controlled viscosity and film-forming behavior drive purchasing decisions. In rinse-off and leave-on cosmetics, including conditioners and body lotions, they build emulsion structure and improve sensory texture. Styling creams and other personal care products benefit from the stability these alcohols provide. Lubricant formulators incorporate them into grease and metalworking fluid compositions to enhance film persistence and reduce friction. At contact surfaces, these long-chain alcohols provide critical protection and durability. Textile processing operations use them as fiber lubricants and softening agents, improving handle and reducing mechanical stress during production. During yarn and fabric manufacturing, they ensure smooth processing and high-quality output. In leather finishing, they contribute to surface conditioning and flexibility in topcoat formulations for a premium finish. The product is supplied as white to off-white waxy flakes or pastilles, with pellet forms available from select producers. It is primarily offered in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet diverse market requirements. Bulk supply is standard in bags or fiber drums, with container quantities available for larger-volume procurement.
